pages.title: Word Bubbles
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Piece together hidden words in Word Bubbles. Start with the category at the top and look for word fragments that can be joined into an answer that fits the topic. One solution can narrow down what the remaining fragments might form. Find every word in the category to finish the level.

pages.title: Perfect Match 3D
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Search a pile of 3D objects for matching sets in Perfect Match 3D. Pick out three identical items at a time and remove them from the board. Look carefully as the pile thins out, since an object you need may be easy to overlook among similar shapes. Later levels give you more objects to sort through.

pages.title: Blocky Archer Run
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Aim a bow while sprinting forward in Blocky Archer Run. Line up your shots with approaching enemies and release before they can stop you. The run continues while you aim, so watch the distance to the next target and judge when to shoot. See how far you can make it before an enemy ends the run.

pages.title: What a walk
pages.creator: Eyestorm Pte. LTD.
pages.description: Pull back and release a floppy leg to take a step in What a walk. Judge how far the leg needs to reach to clear gaps of different widths. Watch where the foot will land so the walker stays out of the water. Touch a flag to set a checkpoint as you make your way through the levels.

pages.title: Maze Craze
pages.creator: Eyestorm Pte. LTD.
pages.description: Find a safe route through the twists and turns in Maze Craze. Look for a way around traps and work out how to reach the items hidden in each maze. Compare the paths before you commit to a turn, since the shortest-looking route can have a hazard in the way. Each layout gives you another route to solve.

pages.title: Hexa Sort Trick or Treat
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Sort colored hexagonal pieces in Hexa Sort Trick or Treat. Drag and drop the pieces into the haunted board and look for placements that bring the colors you need together. Later layouts give you more to consider before you commit to a spot. Check what space will remain after each move so you can keep sorting.

pages.title: That's My Seat Logic Puzzle
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Work out where everyone should sit in That's My Seat Logic Puzzle. Read each character's preferences and place them accordingly. One person might need a window seat, while another wants quiet or distance from someone else. Compare the clues before filling the seats, since a spot that works for one character can leave another without a suitable place.

pages.title: Girl Rescue Dragon Out
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Stop dragons and snakes from reaching a girl in Girl Rescue Dragon Out. Choose a cannon whose color matches a section of the approaching dragon and fire to destroy that part. Check which sections are exposed before choosing the next cannon. Work through the rescue puzzles and use the color-matching mechanic against bosses.

pages.title: Soccer Tournament
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Flick bottle caps around a tabletop pitch in Soccer Tournament. Use the caps on your team to pass the ball, set up a clear line to goal, and take shots. Think about where a cap will finish after the move so you can put it in position for another pass or block the opponent's next play.

pages.title: Star Wing
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Fly Earth's last spacecraft against alien swarms in Star Wing. Move through hazardous areas as the waves of enemy ships get larger. Look for gaps you can use to avoid incoming threats while keeping up your attack. As you progress, upgrade your spacecraft to take on the stronger forces ahead.

pages.title: Christmas Find The Differences
pages.creator: Caner
pages.description: Compare pairs of holiday pictures in Christmas Find The Differences. Look for changes in scenes with Christmas trees, stockings, snowy landscapes, and Santa. Scan corresponding parts of the two pictures and pay attention to small details that are easy to miss. Find every difference in a pair to finish that scene.

pages.title: Fruit Candy Merge
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Bring identical pieces together in Fruit Candy Merge to create new fruit and candy combinations. Look at where each piece can reach a match before you place it. A merge changes the space you have for the next pieces, so keep track of nearby matches as you work toward larger combinations.

pages.title: Sheep Sort Puzzle Sort Color
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Move sheep between pens in Sheep Sort Puzzle Sort Color. The level is solved once each occupied enclosure contains sheep of a single color. Decide where to send a sheep by looking at which animals you need to separate first. Leave room in a pen when you know you'll need it for another move.

pages.title: Bff Weekend Style
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Pick weekend outfits for Dee Dee, Noah, and Willow in Bff Weekend Style. The three friends want to try different looks before they head out to visit new places. Browse their wardrobes and decide what suits each girl. You can give them separate styles or put together outfits that look good as a group.

pages.title: Soccer Merge
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Build a football team by winning competitions in Soccer Merge. Score more goals than your opponent before time runs out, then put your earnings toward bringing better players to your side. Play against opponents online and use each match as a chance to improve the lineup for the next one.

pages.title: Candy Rain 6
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Line up matching sweets in Candy Rain 6. Work through a series of match-three boards and pay attention to the current puzzle as the pieces shift. Look for a move that brings three candies together and check what the match opens up. Each new layout changes which sweets you can bring into a group.

pages.title: Bubble UP Master
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Aim and fire colored bubbles in Bubble UP Master. Send each shot toward a group of the same color to make a combination and clear part of the board. Use power-ups when they can help you get through a difficult section. Clear the remaining bubbles while trying to improve your score.

pages.title: Bubble Pop Butterfly
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Free butterflies by clearing bubbles in Bubble Pop Butterfly. Aim your shot at a matching color and see which butterflies you can release by popping the bubbles around them. The 300 stages take you through different boards with day and night backgrounds. Try to free every butterfly while working toward a high score.

pages.title: HEXAMERGE
pages.creator: AlexGames!
pages.description: Build higher numbers by merging hexagonal tiles in HEXAMERGE. Drag tiles onto the grid and place three or more of the same value together to combine them. Tap a paired piece to rotate it before placing it. Watch the upcoming tiles and keep some room on the board for combinations you can set up later.

pages.title: Bff St Patricks day Look
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Dress the friends for a St. Patrick's Day party in Bff St Patricks day Look. Start with the holiday's green palette and choose an outfit for each girl. Then try hats, hairstyles, and accessories to finish the look. Use different combinations to give each friend her own take on the same celebration.

pages.title: Cat Lovescapes
pages.creator: Brave Giant LTD
pages.description: Play Cat Cupid and help a black cat reach a white cat in Cat Lovescapes. Click around Grandma's house to find ways to distract the other cats and slip past obstacles. If a plan fails, you'll return to the beginning of the room. Work out how to get through each room without Grandma stopping the visit.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Hexagon
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Fire hexagonal bubbles at matching colors in Bubble Shooter Hexagon. Aim each shot so it joins similar bubbles and clears space on the board. Remove all the bubbles before time runs out, and keep them from reaching the border. The 48 levels give you different layouts to aim through.

pages.title: 100 Doors: Escape Puzzle
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Search each room for clues in 100 Doors: Escape Puzzle. Examine the scene for hidden objects and use what you find to solve logic puzzles and minigames. Work out how the clues relate to the lock before you try the door. Opening it lets you move on to another room with a different puzzle.

pages.title: Mini Survival Challenge
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Try to escape a desert island while other players compete in Mini Survival Challenge. Look at how each scene is laid out and use the props available to you to get past hazards. Watch for monsters and traps when deciding where to go. A safe route can change as you move through the challenges.

pages.title: Wall Of Box
pages.creator: Andy Games
pages.description: Try to stay on a wall of cubes in Wall Of Box. Choose a number to find out which obstacle you'll face, then see whether your position holds up. The last person still on the wall wins. Up to four friends can share a computer, so everyone can take part in the same contest.

pages.title: Dressing Up Rush
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Collect clothes that match the target outfit in Dressing Up Rush. Slide to steer and pick up the pieces you need as you go down the track. Pay attention to what the game wants you to wear at the finish. The closer your outfit is to the example, the better your chance of winning.

pages.title: Hexagon
pages.creator: K17 Games
pages.description: Finish with the most pieces on a hexagonal grid in Hexagon. Move or duplicate your pieces and turn opposing pieces to your side as you take territory. Consider what your opponent can convert on the next turn before you choose a move. A built-in tutorial explains how the pieces work.

pages.title: Monster Truck 3D Winter
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description: Drive through winter tracks in Monster Truck 3D Winter. Test your times against a ghost of an earlier run, or race a friend in split-screen mode. Use drifting to handle turns, hit nitro when you have space to accelerate, and try tricks along the course. The solo mode gives you a way to compare your own runs.

pages.title: Squid Craft Online
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Listen to the robot girl in Squid Craft Online. Drag to run while she's speaking and stop moving the instant she goes quiet. If you keep going after that point, you'll be eliminated. Get to the end before time runs out as you work through five worlds built around the same stop-and-go rule.

pages.title: Squid Game 2
pages.creator: tinyDream
pages.description: Time your run past the watching doll in Squid Game 2. Move while the doll is looking away and stop before it turns back. The other contestants are trying to survive the same challenge, so use each opening to make progress without getting caught moving. Play through the contest to earn money and try to finish as the winner.

pages.title: Brick Out 240
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description: Keep the ball above the paddle and break bricks in Brick Out 240. Some colored blocks take several hits, while solid ones can't be broken and change how the ball rebounds. Follow the bounce before moving the paddle into position. There are 240 levels to clear and six power-ups to use along the way.

pages.title: Coloring Book Toy Shop
pages.creator: crazyschoolgames
pages.description: Choose colors for toy drawings in Coloring Book Toy Shop. Left-click to paint the toys and work through one part of each picture at a time. Decide whether to use the same palette across the toy or give its details different colors. Each drawing is a chance to try another combination.

pages.title: Idle Balls
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Hit dumplings to earn leaves in Idle Balls. Click them yourself or let the balls you own bounce into them automatically. Spend the leaves on stronger balls or upgrade the ones already in play. Build up your collection as your bouncing team brings in more leaves for the next purchase.

pages.title: Tricky Track 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Race through an obstacle course in Tricky Track 3D. Throw a ball at your own target to make the route easier, or aim at your rival's target to make their path harder. Decide whether to clear a way ahead or slow the competition. Time the throw while you're still close enough to hit the target you want.

pages.title: School Bus Simulation
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Drive a school bus to its destination and park it in School Bus Simulation. Use WASD to guide the bus through the street and line it up for the parking maneuver. Give yourself room to turn the long vehicle as you approach. Finish by bringing the bus into its spot.

pages.title: Crazy Dentist
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description: Work through dental tasks in Crazy Dentist. Use the mouse to choose and handle the tools as you brush teeth and carry out repairs. Pay attention to which part of the mouth needs work before using the next instrument. The game takes you through several activities you might see in a dentist's office.

pages.title: Fish Live Makeover
pages.creator: Inspire Game Studio
pages.description: Choose a fish and give it a makeover in Fish Live Makeover. Follow the prompts to work through the bath and dress-up activities, then decide how you want the fish to look. The game takes you from selecting the fish to caring for it and styling it in separate scenes.

pages.title: Stencil Art
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Spray paint over stencils to reveal pictures in Stencil Art. Use the spray can to cover the open parts of each design and see the picture take shape. Try another stencil after finishing one and experiment with different colors as you get them. The outline is already there, so you can focus on how you fill it.

pages.title: Jet Ski Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Put jet ski pictures back together in Jet Ski Slide. Shift the pieces and use details from the watercraft and its surroundings to tell where they belong. Choose from three pictures and three puzzle modes. Try another mode to work through the same picture with a different arrangement.

pages.title: Pop The Sugar
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Pop sugar cubes before time runs out in Pop The Sugar. Both brown and white cubes appear, and some are harder to break than others. Keep an eye on the clock when choosing which cube to go after next. The challenge gets harder the longer you keep clearing cubes.

pages.title: Klondike Solitaire
pages.creator: TapLabGames
pages.description: Build four foundations from ace to king by suit in Klondike Solitaire. Rearrange the columns in descending order and alternate colors to make more cards accessible. Move cards to the foundations when their suit and rank are ready. Clearing an exposed card can turn up a card you need farther down the column.

pages.title: Running Pumpkin
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Run as far as you can in Running Pumpkin. Jump across holes and take out enemies that stand in your way. Watch the route ahead so you know whether the next obstacle calls for a jump or an attack. Keep the pumpkin moving and see how far you can get before the run ends.

pages.title: Pool Buddy 2
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Guide water into a pool so Buddy can swim in Pool Buddy 2. Look at which pins are holding the water back and work out which one to move first. Open a route to the pool and let the water flow through. Each level puts the pins and pool in a different arrangement.

pages.title: Police Car vs Thief
pages.creator: Bubito
pages.description: Escape police cars while picking up money in Police Car vs Thief. Steer through the 3D chase and watch where the pursuing vehicles are closing in. Go for cash when you can reach it without getting trapped. The survival run lasts until you're taken out, so the route you choose matters as much as the pickups.

pages.title: Baked Ziti
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Make a baked ziti from scratch in Baked Ziti. Follow Mom's directions and carry out the recipe steps as they appear. Keep the ingredients and preparation in the order the game asks for. The game times your progress, so finish the dish promptly to work toward a higher score.

pages.title: Jumper Jam 2
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Jump from platform to platform in Jumper Jam 2. Tap or click to jump and watch where the next platform sits before you move. Keep landing safely to continue climbing through the endless course. Each attempt gives you a chance to go farther and improve your highest score.

pages.title: Space Attack
pages.creator: KidsGames4All
pages.description: Protect Earth from asteroids and small planets in Space Attack. Use the mouse to move and shoot, and keep track of your ammunition as targets approach. You can earn more ammo and points at the end of a level. Try the different ships and lasers and improve your ship's protection as the attacks continue.

pages.title: Super Car Crash
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Drive a car past crushing obstacles in Super Car Crash. Use the mouse, Up arrow, or Space to move the car. Watch the crushers and wait for a gap before you drive into their path. Time your advances to make it through the course and reach the finish without getting smashed.

pages.title: Boat Drive
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Take a boat or submarine out in Boat Drive, a 3D driving simulator. Choose from three boats and try the two available environments. Use the open water to practice turns and drifting, then switch vehicles to see how another one handles. The submarine gives you a different way to explore the setting.

pages.title: Free New York Taxi Driver 3D Sim
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Drive a yellow cab or a London cab in Free New York Taxi Driver 3D Sim. Start in Career mode to take on taxi driving assignments and get used to handling the cab you chose. As you work through the jobs, practice driving through the city and getting your taxi where it needs to be.

pages.title: Dino Transport Simulator
pages.creator: Flick Gamer
pages.description: Move caged dinosaurs from one location to another in Dino Transport Simulator. Pick up the load and get it to the delivery point before dropping it off. Keep the cage in mind while handling the vehicle through the route. A transport is complete once the dinosaur reaches the intended destination.

pages.title: Fishing
pages.creator: jogosonlineapps.com.br
pages.description: Catch fish against the clock in Fishing. Watch the fish moving below the boat and send the hook down when a catch is within reach. Keep track of the time and the worms available while you try to raise your score. Watch for sharks and look out for pickups that add time or bait.

pages.title: Magic Dash
pages.creator: Playschoolgames
pages.description: Jump over hazards on an endless road in Magic Dash. Collect bonuses to gain strength while keeping the run going. Look ahead so you can decide when to jump and which pickups you can reach safely. Each attempt gives you a chance to earn more points and move up the leaderboard.

pages.title: Airplane Parking Mania Simulator 2019
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: Taxi an airplane around the airport in Airplane Parking Mania Simulator 2019. Find the assigned bay and steer the plane there without rushing the turns. Take the size of the aircraft into account when you approach the parking area. Finish by placing it safely in the correct bay.

pages.title: FZ Halloween Bubble Shooter
pages.creator: NoticeGames.com
pages.description: Shoot groups of matching colors in FZ Halloween Bubble Shooter. Use the mouse or touch to aim a bubble at two or more of the same color and pop them together. Look at what will still be on the board before taking the shot, then keep clearing groups to build your score.

pages.title: Delicate Dracula Dress Up
pages.creator: Girls Games
pages.description: Pick a new outfit for Draculaura in Delicate Dracula Dress Up. Search the Monster High vampire's wardrobe for pieces that suit her style, including her favorite color, pink. Use the mouse to put a look together. Try several outfits to see which one you'd send her to school in.

pages.title: Moto Beach Ride
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Ride a motorcycle across side-scrolling courses in Moto Beach Ride. Use the arrow keys or touch controls to guide the bike toward the finish line. Collect gold coins on the way and see how fast you can finish without losing control. There are eight levels across two different locations.

pages.title: Rabbit Shooter
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Hunt rabbits in Rabbit Shooter. Use the right mouse button to aim and the left button to fire once you have a clear shot. Scroll to switch weapons and press R to reload. Watch the area for the next rabbit while you decide whether to take the shot or change position.

pages.title: Galactic Missile Defense
pages.creator: Black Sheep Games
pages.description: Defend Earth with three anti-missile bases in Galactic Missile Defense. Tap in the direction you want to shoot and clear the aliens on screen to reach the next stage. Upgrade the bases with weapons and boosters as the attacks intensify. Decide which base needs help most before you spend an upgrade.

pages.title: Esplodi Bolla V
pages.creator: Nj developer Studio
pages.description: Pop colored bubbles in sequence in Esplodi Bolla V. Tap the bubbles on a touchscreen or use the left mouse button to select them. Leave the five black bubbles alone as you work through the other colors. The challenge is keeping track of the order while spotting the next bubble you need.

pages.title: Impossible Moto Bike Track Stunts
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Ride a motorcycle along elevated stunt tracks in Impossible Moto Bike Track Stunts. Use WASD to drive and Space to brake as you line up ramps and narrow stretches of road. Press C to change the camera when another view would help. Judge the approach to each stunt before accelerating.

pages.title: Candy Rush Saga
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Line up matching sweets in Candy Rush Saga. Use the mouse to make groups of three candies of the same kind. See how the layout changes when those candies clear, then use the pieces left behind to set up another match. Look for a move that brings the next group together.

pages.title: Squares Challenge
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Connect squares of the same color in Squares Challenge. Check which color the board asks you to collect and look for the longest chain you can make with it. Sometimes you need to clear a group of a different color first to set up the line you want. Use the mouse to make your connections.

pages.title: Luxury SUV Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Reassemble pictures of luxury SUVs in Luxury SUV Puzzle. Choose one of six images and a puzzle size of 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces. Look for parts of the vehicle and background that line up across neighboring pieces. Pick a larger piece count if you want to try the same image again with smaller details to match.

pages.title: Street Racing Mania
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Race through five street courses in Street Racing Mania. Drive by day and night and watch for police cars, pedestrians, and computer-controlled rivals on the road. Finish a race to earn money for upgrades or a better car. Use the game's tap controls to handle each run and see what your new setup can do.

pages.title: Trivia Quiz
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Answer questions in Trivia Quiz. Read each question, compare the choices, and click the answer you think fits. Some choices may sound plausible at first, so check the wording before you select one. Work through the questions and see which facts you can recall on the spot.

pages.title: BFF's Tournament
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Choose sports outfits in BFF's Tournament. Moana is entering an equestrian event, Elsa is playing badminton, and Kristoff is competing in weightlifting. Use the mouse to put together a different look for each competitor. Think about the event each character is entering as you decide what they should wear.

pages.title: Space Frontier Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Launch a rocket in Space Frontier Online and see how high it can fly. Click or tap to release each stage at the right moment as the rocket climbs. The timing of those separations determines how far the launch goes. Use the currency from successful flights to buy new parts and styles.

pages.title: Cats Winter Fun
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Dress a group of cats for a snowy day in Cats Winter Fun. Pick clothes for the cats before they head outside to play. Try different combinations and choose a look for each cat that fits the winter outing. The snowfall sets the scene for the outfits you put together.

pages.title: The Sorcerer
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Fire colored balls into a moving chain in The Sorcerer. Aim with the mouse and put each shot where it can join balls of the same color. Clear the groups before the chain gets too far along its route. The three stages increase in difficulty as you get used to aiming into the moving line.

pages.title: Summer Beach Outfits
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Get the princesses ready for a beach fashion show in Summer Beach Outfits. Apply their makeup first, then browse the clothing and other fashion items for the runway. Decide how each outfit should fit with the makeup you chose. Put together different looks for the girls before they go on.

pages.title: Marry Me Kitty
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Get Kitty ready for her wedding in Marry Me Kitty. Choose a wedding dress, shoes, and accessories for her to wear when her friends arrive. Once the outfit is ready, move on to the garden and decorate it for the ceremony. You can style both the bride and the place where the wedding happens.

pages.title: Magic Solitaire: World
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Clear the board with help from a group of rabbits in Magic Solitaire: World. Choose an exposed card one rank above or below the current card to keep a sequence going. Draw from the deck when you have no move. Collect coins and boosters as you make your way through the layouts.

pages.title: Potty Train Baby Elsa
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Help Baby Elsa with potty training in Potty Train Baby Elsa. First use a magnifying glass to find the potty, toilet paper, her favorite book, soap, and a towel. Then follow the steps to help her use the potty and learn the hygiene routine that comes afterward. Finish by choosing clothes for her.

pages.title: School Break Mall Shopping
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Pass a note at the right moment and head to the mall in School Break Mall Shopping. Once the students get to the store, put together a new outfit for one of them. Choose clothes, shoes, and accessories that work together. Keep an eye on the time while you decide what to buy.
